summary: Released hierarchical ablation composes planner targets1,5,9,13 with a four-action IDM trained on endpoints4,8,12,16. Exact supported-horizon diagnostic demonstrates invalid temporal composition. Major is scoped to this core released comparator; historical Table4 binding remains Needs Evidence. problems.title: Hierarchical planner and IDM use incompatible endpoint times
problems.claim: Section5.5/Table4 uses a four-step hierarchical comparator to support dense forecasting as an important contribution.
problems.location: PDF p8 Section5.5/Table4 andp15; agent/ldp_hier_agent.py115,126-128,383-401,415,431-459,600-620; hierarchy YAML and evaluation route
assumptions: Current pinned public revision; historical experiment binding unavailable
Explicit horizon17 override, obs_horizon1, idm_horizon4, action_horizon4; constructor divisibility satisfied
Four-subgoal U-Net path statically shape-compatible; ordinary default launch not certified and author runtime not executed
Exact scalar dynamics s_next=s+a; normalized latent z=s/16 in[0,1]
Exact expert planner and four-action inverse with supported constant velocities1 and1/4
problems.check: Evaluate actual slices independently. Planner indices1,5,9,13; IDM pairs(0,4),(4,8),(8,12),(12,16); inference pairs(0,1),(1,5),(5,9),(9,13). Four-action inverse outputs four copies of(v-u)/4.
problems.result: Supported Ha4 returns16 primitive actions: first four.25, remaining12ones; state after4 is1 versus intended4; state after16 is13 versus16. Source environment executes full returned chunk. No persistent quarter-speed claim; Ha1 excluded by constructor.
problems.counterevidence: Dense implementation aligns correctly. Historical corrected branch/learned compensation/configuration could affect scores; no run binding. Hierarchical IDM also changes architecture. Static selectable configuration, no executed initialization.
problems.impact: Released implementation of core dense-forecasting ablation does not implement its stated four-step comparator. Historical Table4 score damage or ranking reversal is not established; heterogeneous-data conclusions do not depend on this defect.
problems.correction: Planner target slice starts obs_horizon-1+idm_horizon with same stride; define execution horizon in primitive actions and match schedules/architecture before rerunning.
problems.repair_verification: Exact slice and rational dynamics repair verified; full training, initialization, repaired benchmark and historical binding not performed.
